title: host.update_csm (platform → host)
description: Update csm itself to its newest release (csm self-update), for a host that advertises `update.csm`. Running servers are not touched; the host agent restarts onto the new csm, so it answers before updating. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock.

version.description: The release the platform saw as newest (informational: csm installs its latest).
